title: Whitley Strieber's blue beings, the cobalts

tellings.quote: Whitley Strieber talks about them. He calls them cobalts.

plain: The author Whitley Strieber, who has written about his own encounters with otherworldly beings, describes a kind of blue being that he calls the cobalts. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic phenomena, mentions this in passing, repeating Strieber's account, as one more type of being that people say they have met.
